summary: Formats a raw time value into a debug display string with a unit suffix via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck. Combines register inputs (LOBYTE(_EAX) = BYTE1(_ECX) + _EAX); when the high bit (_EAX & 0x80) of the result is set it increments a dword counter at a3 + 1149962476, indexes a float lookup table inside _ECX (base offset 1CD8h, element index (_EAX & 0xC) * 4), scales that value by dbl_59EA20 and points v7 at the unit-suffix string (_ECX + 24). If the dword at _ECX + 4 equals 1 the scaled value is formatted with "%.2f %s" (a2fS at 0x005C3820) and returned; otherwise the value is scaled by dbl_59EA18 and formatted with "%.3f %s" (a3fS at 0x005C3780).

local_names.v8: scaled value for the two-decimal path
local_names.v6: scaled value for the three-decimal path

operations.description: Combine incoming register bytes: LOBYTE(_EAX) = BYTE1(_ECX) + _EAX.
If (_EAX & 0x80) is nonzero (high bit set), take the alternate lookup-and-scale path.
Increment the dword counter at a3 + 1149962476.
Mask the accumulator to (_EAX & 0xC) and load a float from the lookup table at _ECX + (_EAX & 0xC) * 4 + 1CD8h.
Multiply the lookup-table value by dbl_59EA20 (0x0059EA20).
Set v7 = (const char *)(_ECX + 24), the unit-suffix string pointer.
If *(_DWORD *)(_ECX + 4) equals 1, select the two-decimal format path.
Call StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a5, "%.2f %s", scaled value, v7) using the two-decimal format string (a2fS at 0x005C3820).
Return the formatted string produced by the two-decimal path.
Multiply the pending time value by dbl_59EA18 (0x0059EA18).
Call StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(a5, "%.3f %s", scaled value, v7) using the three-decimal format string (a3fS at 0x005C3780).
Return the formatted string produced by the three-decimal path.

Purpose and scale of the float lookup table at _ECX + (_EAX & 0xC) * 4 + 1CD8h are unknown.
